name: Molang
description: Molang is an affectionate and humorous perspective on the relationship between an eccentric, joyful, and enthusiastic rabbit and a shy, discreet, and emotional little chick. Despite their many differences, these two enjoy a unique friendship. They have great times together ranging from the mundane to the extraordinary. Whether they're flying to the moon or merely watering the vegetable patch, Molang and Piu Piu experience unexpected, even unsettling situations. Tricky incidents and misunderstandings are soon transformed into opportunities for fun moments and humor, which Molang's friends are happy to come and share in.

videos.title: A Bumpy Vacation
videos.overview: Molang, Piu Piu, and their friend are on vacation. A turtle carries their friend to an uninhabited island and Molang and Piu Piu rush over to his aid. The strong waves make it difficult for them to return to their resort, but Piu Piu discovers their friend's unusual talent can help them overcome the obstacles.

videos.title: Beneath the Ocean
videos.overview: As Molang and Piu Piu walk down the pier in their wetsuits and with their scuba gear, their friends warn them of a deep sea monster. It turns out to be a mermaid whose singing frightens them at first, but Molang and Piu Piu help him to sing in tune.

videos.title: The RV
videos.overview: On the way to the beach in their new RV, Molang and Piu Piu find a band stranded on the road. They're happy to help, but it becomes a race against time as they have to get the band to their ship before it leaves.

videos.title: The Ghost's Castle
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu go trick or treating but no one has any candy left. Heading towards a castle, a friend warns them they might find a ghost, but nothing can get in the way of their quest for candy.

videos.title: The Mummy
videos.overview: Visiting an exhibit on Ancient Egypt, Molang and Piu Piu find inspiration for their Halloween costumes - mummies! However, that evening a storm breaks out, lightning strikes and the famous Momoferty Mummy awakes.

videos.title: The Magic Wand
videos.overview: It's decided, for Halloween, Molang will dress up as a wizard and Piu Piu as a pumpkin! When they go trick or treating, Molang bumps into a real wizard, and neither realises their wands have been swapped.

videos.title: The Snowman
videos.overview: It's snowing in front of Molang and Piu Piu's home, and our two friends decide to build a snowman. A hat on its head, a scarf around its neck, a carrot as a nose and two candied chestnuts for its eyes, and it's done! However, the nearby animals are quick to take all of its decorations. Molang and Piu Piu discover that the animals are hungry and cold, and leave presents for them.

videos.title: At the Elves' Home
videos.overview: As they go ice-skating, Molang invites Piu Piu to dance. The two friends have so much fun that when they spin, Molang loses his grip on Piu Piu who flies through the air and lands in the forest, knocking him out. Santa's elves, who look just like Piu Piu, find him while Piu Piu struggles to remember who he is.

videos.title: A Beautiful Christmas Tree
videos.overview: Christmas is coming. Molang and Piu Piu decide to go into the forest to fetch a great big Christmas tree for their home. They find one that is so heavy that it won't budge, however much they pull or push it. They run into Santa's reindeer and accidentally set them loose, and they help Santa bring them back to his sleigh.

videos.title: The Instructions
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu want to build a covered verandah in their garden, but it's a very difficult project. Worse, they lose the building instructions to a gust of wind.

videos.title: The Flying Carpet
videos.overview: While on a desert expedition with some pals, Molang and Piu Piu ride a camel, but the camel's loping walk makes them seasick.

videos.title: Top Model
videos.overview: Molang has fun trying on various outfits in front of Piu Piu, who thinks Molang would make an excellent top model.

videos.title: The Rock Band
videos.overview: While at a rock band audition, Molang and Piu Piu's enthusiastic friend tries his hardest to join the group but causes small catastrophes instead.

videos.title: The Delivery Men
videos.overview: While hiking in the mountains, Molang and Piu Piu try to help the delivery man who doesn't realize he's dropping his cargo behind him.

videos.title: Firefighters
videos.overview: Full of admiration for firemen, Molang and Piu Piu want to become firemen themselves. They pass several tests, but don't have all the skills it takes.

videos.title: Santa
videos.overview: It's Christmas Eve. Molang and Piu Piu decorate the tree, but it sways dangerously. When Santa Claus arrives, the tree falls over, knocking him out!

videos.title: The Box
videos.overview: When Molang and Piu Piu see that their friend has "forgotten" his cardboard box, they bring it to him. Embarrassed, their pal pretends nothing happened.

videos.title: The Mule
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu fly to Peru and want to go exploring with their friends, but all the llamas are already taken. They're left with only a mule.

videos.title: The Magic Lamp
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are in the desert without any water. They fall off their camel, which abandons them! As they walk across the desert, they find an old oil lamp. Could there be a genie inside?

videos.title: The Yeti
videos.overview: While in Tibet, Molang and Piu Piu want to go hiking in the mountains but are warned by the villagers that there's a yeti up there.

videos.title: At The Fair
videos.overview: As they stroll through a small funfair, Molang spots a stuffed animal he wants: a pretty pink unicorn. Piu Piu does everything to win it for him, but unfortunately, without success.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu go surfing, but a large wave beaches a whale. Molang and Piu Piu immediately begin a rescue operation to help the poor whale back into the water.

videos.title: The Detectives
videos.overview: Whenever Molang loses something, Piu Piu always finds it. This amazing ability of Piu Piu's inspires them to become private detectives: Piu Piu Holmes and Molang Watson.

videos.title: The Bodyguards
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu go to a pop star's concert, but after the show, they find that the star is afraid of his adoring fans. Molang and Piu Piu offer to be his bodyguards.

videos.title: The Alien
videos.overview: While waiting for their friends to arrive, Molang and Piu Piu finish their party preparations. They're setting everything up in the moonlight when an alien spaceship crashes in their garden.

videos.title: The Whale
videos.overview: During an ice fishing trip, Molang and Piu Piu enlist the help of friends all around the world to free a whale trapped in a floe.

videos.title: The Spider
videos.overview: After being unable to chase a spider out of the house, Molang and Piu Piu learn martial arts to defend themselves.

videos.title: Watch Out
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu go out to a restaurant, but inadvertently cause a waiter to slip and fall. To help the restaurant owner, Molang and Piu Piu replace the waiter.

videos.title: Super Molang
videos.overview: Molang puts on a real superhero's costume giving him the power to fly as well as incredible strength, but they soon discover that with great power comes great responsibility.

videos.title: The Frog
videos.overview: During the cold winter, Molang and Piu Piu rescue a frozen frog and heal it. They find out what happens if the frog is a king who has been turned into a frog, and how they can turn him back into a prince.

videos.title: Electro Molang
videos.overview: After getting struck by lightning. Molang is supercharged with electricity. Can this new ability zap the town's power problems?

videos.title: The Knight
videos.overview: On a hike in the mountains, Piu Piu falls into a crevasse and finds a creature frozen in a block of ice. They bring it back home and the block of ice melts, revealing a genuine knight.

videos.title: The Easter Eggs
videos.overview: Piu Piu trains for the annual Easter Egg hunt but then on the big day, becomes so overexcited, he can't find a single egg!

videos.title: The Space Friends
videos.overview: Extraterrestrials have been observing Molang and Piu Piu from outer space and are astonished to see them laugh. They teleport them to their spaceship and attempt to discover the meaning of laughter.

videos.title: The Choir
videos.overview: It's Christmas, so Molang and Piu Piu have started a chorus with Piu Piu as the lead singer. Just before his solo at the Christmas concert Piu Piu hurts his voice, so Molang comes up with a clever way to help.

videos.title: The Dragon
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are house-sitting a friend's castle when a sheep wanders inside and accidentally knocks a dragon egg into the fire. The egg hatches, and a baby dragon emerges!

videos.title: Shuuuuush!!
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu discover their new neighbour is a famous pianist. They try their hardest to make sure they don't make a single sound so he can concentrate.

videos.title: The Ghost
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu's house is haunted by a phantom saxophonist. At first they are terrified of the spooky ghost, but after a while they decide to come to terms with it.

videos.title: A New Friend
videos.overview: Piu Piu wins a goldfish at the fair for Molang, but he becomes jealous of his friend's closeness to the fish.

videos.title: Mini Molang
videos.overview: On their way to visit an inventor friend, Molang and Piu Piu inadvertently activate a machine which they think does nothing, but the next morning they wake up and discover they have been shrunk!

videos.title: The Haunted House
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu arrive at a hotel in a castle. They are warmly greeted by their friend, the owner. But at night, they discover the castle is haunted!

videos.title: The Condor
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are exploring the mountains on the back of a llama when a mother condor mistakes Piu Piu for her missing baby.

videos.title: The Broom
videos.overview: A witch's spirited broom lands next to Molang and Piu Piu. Molang tries to clean with the broom, but it wakes up, and a magical rodeo ensues.

videos.title: Actor Molang
videos.overview: Molang is hired to play the lead role in a play at the theatre. Unfortunately, during rehearsals on stage, Molang constantly has difficulty with the same line, messing it up over and over again.

videos.title: Skate Supreme
videos.overview: Molang tries to ride a skateboard, much to Piu Piu's dismay and panic, as Molang isn't very skilled and keeps falling over, but in a stroke of improbable luck, Molang manages to execute a trick.

videos.title: Mega Piu Piu
videos.overview: After Piu Piu struggles with being so small, Molang has an inventor friend help Piu Piu grow to the same size as Molang.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are hiking through the forest on a camping trip. Unfortunately, there is a fierce and brutal wind which causes birds' nests to fall out of trees and squirrels' nuts to go flying. Molang and Piu Piu rush to help the animals. When they subsequently get lost in the forest, it's the animals' turn to come to their rescue.

videos.title: The Turtle
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu try their best to help a new friend, a turtle whose flipper is stuck in a plastic bag.

videos.title: The Birdling
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu help hatch and care for a baby bird so well that it doesn't want to leave and join its fellow birds.

videos.title: The Cap
videos.overview: After accidentally ruining Piu Piu's new cap, Molang learns he may need to travel to Peru to get a replacement.

videos.title: Elves
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are playing hockey in Lapland, but poor Piu Piu, who is so much smaller than the others, is stuck watching on the bench. Disappointed, he walks away...and falls into a secret tunnel that leads directly to Santa Claus' workshop.

videos.title: Into The Wild
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu meet up with a pal to go hiking in the mountains. Their pal, a big fan of high-tech gadgets, has a super cool, high-tech backpack that makes his life much easier.

videos.title: The Panda
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are hiking in China when they see a baby panda reach for a bamboo shoot and miss, falling into a ravine. The pair spring into action to rescue the baby.

videos.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentices
videos.overview: During a walk in the forest, Molang and Piu Piu find a sorcerer's hut. Curious, they enter and find a magic wand that allows them to do incredible things. But they don't master the wand's powers, and they inadvertently end up turning the sorcerer into a frog.

videos.title: The Sand Statue
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are on the beach. Seeing Piu Piu having fun drawing shapes in the sand, Molang gets an idea: they'll sculpt a statue of themselves out of sand.

videos.title: The Pullover
videos.overview: With a great deal of love, Piu Piu knits a handsome sweater for Molang, but as soon as it tries it on, Molang realizes that the sweater is very itchy.

videos.title: The Dancers
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu watch a dance performance rehearsal, but the dancers are not able to perform a particular move: a lift. But then the choreographer decides Piu Piu is the perfect person for the show.

videos.title: The Husky
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are in the Canadian wilderness when they decide to head for a sunny island. They're loading their suitcases onto the snowmobile when a husky emerges from the forest, approaches them... and steals the snowmobile keys.

videos.title: The Call Of The Forest
videos.overview: After discovering an abandoned puppy in the far north, Molang and Piu Piu train it to become a sled dog.

videos.title: The Competition
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu participate in strength challenges but Piu Piu is made fun of for his size.

videos.title: The Long Trip
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are out flying kites when they disturb a flock of migrating storks, discombobulating one of the storks.

videos.title: To the Shelter
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu lead a pleasant and quiet life in the shelter of a tree. But one day, a mammoth crashes, head down, into their tree which falls over with a terrible noise.

videos.title: The New World
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are walking along when they come across a young navigator searching for a crew to go on the discovery of uncharted lands, and the two friends embark on a long voyage.

videos.title: The Tourney
videos.overview: Piu Piu and Molang deliver bread to a medieval village market. Everything is arranged for the splendid knight tournament. Molang swoons and falls in front of some lances.

videos.title: The Wig
videos.overview: When Louis the XIVth's valet accidentally crushes the kings' wig, he rushes off to the wigmakers that are Molang and Piu Piu, and the two friends work hard to create a splendid new wig.

videos.title: The Berries
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu go berry picking and find out that an extraordinary adventure unfolding before them.

videos.title: The Pigeon
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are assistants to the artist Leonardo da Vinci. To catch a disobedient homing pigeon, they multiply their attempts. However, one of them is a genius idea from Leonardo.

videos.title: The Elixir
videos.overview: A frightened horse pulling a chariot behind him enters a village in the Far West. Molang and Piu Piu manage to stop the animal and discover with surprise the contents of the chariot.

videos.title: The Cherries
videos.overview: In Prehistory, Molang and Piu Piu go cherry picking. But the country walk ends up becoming a perilous adventure. From here the invention of agriculture!

videos.title: The Gardens of Versailles
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu play hide and seek with their friend in the garden of the castle of Versailles. The garden is abundant and his friend, who is not very good at seeking, never finds them.

videos.title: The Sabre Tooth Kitten
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu can't resist rescuing an adorable baby saber tooth tiger, but they'll need to return the kitten before it goes from cute to killer.

videos.title: The Chariot Race
videos.overview: In antiquity Molang and Piu Piu are watching a chariot race. However, one of the competitors must declare forfeit and offers Molang to replace them.

videos.title: The River
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu find themselves unfortunately separated, each one on a different river bank. They are trying all they can to reunite but its difficult because in prehistory, bridges don't exist.

videos.title: The Hot Air Balloon
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu meet the Montgolfier brothers, who are trying to find a friend who can test their balloon. All their friends refuse except for Piu Piu, who wants to discover the world from above.

videos.title: Knights & Dragons
videos.overview: When knights attempt to fight a dragon, Molang and Piu Piu are instructed to prepare some food for them. But first they must start a fire to cook.

videos.title: Excalibur
videos.overview: The one who manages to remove the sword from the stone will be crowned king. Out of all the knights who attempted this challenge, it is the smallest of them all who succeeds: Piu Piu.

videos.title: Cyclops
videos.overview: During antiquity, Molang and Piu Piu are shipwrecked and their raft washes up on an island. Relieved, they go in search of friends, but they are about to make an extraordinary meeting.

videos.title: The Perfume
videos.overview: Molang, Piu Piu, and their friends are building pyramids in the extreme heat. Having run out of water, Molang and Piu Piu offer to go and find some.

videos.title: The Cruise
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu envisage to go on a pleasant cruise on the Nile. But in the time of the Pharaohs, to climb onto a boat, one can easily end up on board a galley.

videos.title: The King is Bored
videos.overview: A king bored of his regal duties finds new purpose after spending the day baking bread with Molang and Piu Piu.

videos.title: The King's Necklace
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are cleaning the room where the kings' necklace is displayed. They have been cleaning so well that when the king's advisor collects the necklace, he slips and the necklace flies into the air.

videos.title: The Bicycle
videos.overview: Riding a horse in the Far West is all too easy for all of Piu Piu's friends except for him. So when he comes across a seller of the first bicycle, he jumps at the chance.

videos.title: The Musketeers
videos.overview: When Piu Piu and Molang come to deliver some vegetables to the musketeers, the aforementioned are called to the rescue of the king. Molang and Piu Piu don't hesitate to follow them.

videos.title: The Goose
videos.overview: A noisy goose makes for an unexpected guard animal when a hungry thief keeps stealing grain from Molang and Piu Piu's harvest.

videos.title: The Great Laundry
videos.overview: The king holds a dancing show and Molang and Piu Piu oversee his costume. Catastrophe strikes when the king dirties his costume, but thankfully, Molang and Piu Piu come across some eccentric washer people.

videos.title: The Songbird
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu stop in front of a bird catcher stand whilst a parrot is exchanging a tune with Mozart. And what if the magic flute was written with the intervention of Molang and Piu Piu?

videos.title: Dream Job
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are looking for work. But in the middle ages, most jobs require strength and Piu Piu is way too small to be offered any job.

videos.title: The Curtsey
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are bee keepers who produce such wonderful-tasting honey that the king wants to give them a medal. But in order to receive the medal, they must learn to bow.

videos.title: The Labyrinth
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are shepherds. But Kiki, their little goat, has the urge to freely run about. Escaping from the pen, she leads them to a strange maze.

videos.title: Pegasus
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are handing out mail to their friends. But in antiquity, there are no bicycles, no motorcars, everything is done on foot! Unless of course one meets up with a certain legendary horse.

videos.title: Photography
videos.overview: Molang possesses one of the very first cameras of its time. With much enthusiasm, he photographs all that he sees around him.

videos.title: All the Colours
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are Merlin's apprentices and obey his every order. He goes into the forest and forbids them to use the magic wand, so they must resist its calling.

videos.title: Fire
videos.overview: In prehistory, fire is a key element for survival. So when Molang extinguishes it accidentally, there is only one thing to do: go and find fire in the heart of the great volcano.

videos.title: Aerobatics
videos.overview: A director begs Molang and Piu Piu to fly a film across the sea in time for the premiere, but their trip is more action-packed than the movie itself.

videos.title: Aviation Pioneers
videos.overview: Piu Piu is dreaming that he's flying. And what if his dream became reality? Molang and Piu Piu will do all they can to make this dream come true and thus become the pioneers of aviation.

videos.title: The Samurai
videos.overview: Molang is cleaning a samurai's costume and just can't help but to try it on; Piu Piu admires him all dressed up, but when a panicked peasant arrives to inform the guard that a dragon has attacked his orchard, Molang is immediately required to help.

videos.title: The Musicians
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are strolling in the Savana when a volcano starts to grumble. Persuaded that the volcano is about to erupt, they attempt to warn the animals, but they don't want to follow them.

videos.title: The Circus Games
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu participate in circus games. The two teams confront one another, and the friends are divided between yellow and red supporters. How to bring everyone together?

videos.title: The Mermaids
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are fishing in their boat when they meet some mermaids. Molang, completely mesmerised by the mermaid's song, leaves the boat and puts himself in danger. Piu Piu comes to his rescue!

videos.title: The Wooden Egg
videos.overview: Washed up on an island, Molang and Piu Piu discover an inhabited fort with many Piu Pius. When they welcome Piu Piu with open arms, they don't want to know Molang or any of their other friends, whom they consider their enemies.

videos.title: The Rose
videos.overview: When Molang picks a rose in a garden to give to Piu Piu, he doesn't realise that this rose belongs to someone very scary and very selfish.

videos.title: Treasure Island
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu come across a pirate in search of an island with hidden treasure. However, the treasure is not always where one imagines it might be.

videos.title: The Unicorn
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are out picking up firewood for winter, when they come face to face with a unicorn that has lost its way in the forest. Listening to their heart, our two friends decide to bring it back to the land of unicorns.

videos.title: The Mariachis
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu arrive in a Mexican village. Some mariachis are looking for a couple of musicians to complete their band. With enthusiasm, Molang pleads for Piu Piu to join them too.

videos.title: King Molang
videos.overview: A movie is being filmed on a lost island in the pacific. The main actor makes Molang and Piu Piu run lots of errands. Exhausted, the two friends take refuge on the beach where the meet a funny tribe.

videos.title: Lochness
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are both journalists and are on a mission to bring back a picture of the Loch Ness Monster to make the headlines in their newspaper. But does the monster really exist?

videos.title: The Titanic
videos.overview: Thanks to a lucky ticket from a tombola, Molang and Piu Piu embark on the Titanic. Unfortunately, the two friends are separated in different travel classes.

videos.title: A Great Heart
videos.overview: An inventor buys a clock from Molang and Piu Piu to make the heart of his robot. When the robot comes to life, the inventor is overjoyed. However, there is one small detail, the robot only likes Piu Piu.

videos.title: Zero
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu are working on a ranch. But one of their friends Zero is particularly clumsy with his lasso and is rejected by the others. Molang and Piu Piu don't hesitate to come to his aid.

videos.title: The Vikings
videos.overview: When villagers see some Vikings landing from afar, general panic sets in. Molang and Piu Piu armed with courage, but also with brushes and shampoo are about to transform the faces of their invaders.

videos.title: The Troll
videos.overview: Molang and Piu Piu have decided to build a house in the middle of a beautiful clearing; however, they are not aware of the fact that a grumpy troll lives there too.

videos.title: The Visit
videos.overview: It seems nothing will impress Julius Caesar on his visit to the pharaoh's palace until Molang and Piu Piu hop in and save the day.

videos.title: Hercules
videos.overview: Hercules is a hero who is adored for all his exploits. But in every day life, his strength is not always so helpful. It's up to Molang and Piu Piu to teach him how to be more careful.

country: France, United Kingdom, Mongolia, Canada, South Korea, Israel
